characters.name: KARU PEETER
characters.description: Väike pruun karu, pehmete karvaste kõrvadega, kandmas väikest sinist vesti. Sõbralik ja uudishimulik. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: REBANE REELI
characters.description: Väike oranž rebane, pika koheva sabaga, kandmas väikest rohelist salli. Mänguline ja rõõmsameel. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Metsa Sillerdav Oja
locations.description: Sunny forest clearing with vibrant green grass, tall green trees, and colorful wildflowers scattered around. A small, clear stream with smooth, round river stones runs through the clearing. The atmosphere is bright, cheerful, and inviting. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: KARU PEETER and REBANE REELI are standing in a sunny forest clearing with green grass, tall trees, and colorful wildflowers. They are looking around, smiling. The small, clear stream is visible in the background. KARU PEETER wears a blue vest, REBANE REELI wears a green scarf. Cute cartoon style.

KARU PEETER and REBANE REELI are standing in the sunny forest clearing. KARU PEETER is pointing towards the ground with a thoughtful expression, a friendly smile on his face. REBANE REELI is looking at him with curious, eager eyes. The stream is visible in the background. KARU PEETER wears a blue vest, REBANE REELI wears a green scarf. Cute cartoon style.

KARU PEETER and REBANE REELI are now kneeling near the bank of the small, clear stream in the sunny forest clearing. They are both looking down at the smooth, round river stones by the water's edge, smiling with excitement. KARU PEETER wears a blue vest, REBANE REELI wears a green scarf. Cute cartoon style.

KARU PEETER and REBANE REELI are still kneeling by the stream. KARU PEETER is gently picking up a smooth, colorful stone from the bank. REBANE REELI is eagerly looking at the stones around them. The stream flows gently beside them. KARU PEETER wears a blue vest, REBANE REELI wears a green scarf. Cute cartoon style.

KARU PEETER and REBANE REELI are both holding several smooth, colorful river stones in their paws, showing them to each other. The stones are various shades of blue, red, green, and yellow. They are smiling, happy to see the vibrant colors. They are still kneeling by the stream. KARU PEETER wears a blue vest, REBANE REELI wears a green scarf. Cute cartoon style.

KARU PEETER is kneeling by the stream, carefully placing a blue stone onto a small pile of other collected stones on the green grass next to him. REBANE REELI is watching him, holding a few red stones in her paws. KARU PEETER wears a blue vest, REBANE REELI wears a green scarf. Cute cartoon style.

REBANE REELI is kneeling by the stream, carefully placing a red stone onto a small pile of other collected stones on the green grass. KARU PEETER is next to her, holding a few blue stones. They are both focused on their stone collecting. KARU PEETER wears a blue vest, REBANE REELI wears a green scarf. Cute cartoon style.

KARU PEETER and REBANE REELI are sitting side-by-side on the green grass in the forest clearing. A beautiful, colorful pattern or simple picture, like a sun or a flower, made from their collected smooth river stones is laid out neatly on the grass in front of them. They are smiling proudly at their creation. The stream is still visible in the background. KARU PEETER wears a blue vest, REBANE REELI wears a green scarf. Cute cartoon style.

KARU PEETER and REBANE REELI are still sitting next to their completed colorful stone picture on the green grass. KARU PEETER is pointing at the picture with a paw, and REBANE REELI is clapping her paws together. Both have wide, happy smiles, admiring their art. KARU PEETER wears a blue vest, REBANE REELI wears a green scarf. Cute cartoon style.

KARU PEETER and REBANE REELI are standing up, holding paws, and looking at their beautiful stone picture on the green grass with big, joyful smiles. They are very proud and happy. The sunny forest clearing and stream complete the scene around them. KARU PEETER wears a blue vest, REBANE REELI wears a green scarf. Cute cartoon style.
